# coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab — Complete LLM Context (`llms-full.txt`)

## Summary
Author: Alexander S. Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
Repository: https://github.com/0thernes/coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab
Interactive Proof Blueprint: https://0thernes.github.io/coded-pir-mlwe-complexity-lab/
Version: 5.2.0 | Code License: Apache-2.0 | Paper & Docs License: CC-BY-4.0

This repository delivers 32 zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 theorem bundles (`T1a`–`T3l` & `T1k`), non-degenerate non-vacuity witnesses (`TriadFrontier/NonVacuity.lean`, incl. char-2 `SimpleField (Fin 2)` and concurrent/coplanar `P^3` 4-line witnesses), and 10 boundary tests (`TriadFrontier/AdversarialTests.lean`, **35 audited declarations** + **1,656** `TriadFrontier.*` declarations swept by `AuditExhaustiveAxioms.lean` under Lean 4.35.0 `module`, **4,745** `con-leche`/`con-ron` verified declarations across 6 independent kernels + live negative tamper gate), cross-verified in hardened C11 (`-std=c11 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror`, 88/88 tests + 1,024 fuzz), 60/90-digit Python (`pytest` 25/25 incl. 16/16 killed mutants, Draft 2020-12 `repo.yaml` validation, strict `0 ruff` / `0 mypy`), and hardened Eshkol v1.3.6 forward-mode dual-number AD, together with a zero-warning AMS-LaTeX preprint (`paper/main.tex`, 8 vector PDF figures, 36/36 live HTTP-200 + 30/30 Crossref 0-retraction citations), dual DigiCert RFC 3161 TSA (`data/MANIFEST.sha256.tsr`) + 3-calendar Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (`data/MANIFEST.sha256.ots`) receipts, and a CSP/WCAG-AA interactive Blueprint.

**Honest Scope:** Resolves no grand published open problem in Lean (`0 / 1,900` retired) and refutes no published claim. All 12 paper errata (`A01`–`A12`), all formal errata (`L01`–`L07`), and all script/CI fixes (`S01`–`S04`) from the 2026-11-26 statement audit are fixed across `v5.1.0`–`v5.2.0` (see `ERRATA.md`).

## Pillar I — Coded, Colluding, Robust & Byzantine PIR (`CS-053`)
- `T1a`: Moment-curve annihilation `<u(alpha), e_{r+1} - alpha e_r> = 0` over any `CommRing R`; Pascal binomial identity `K * C(T, T') = (K+T-T') * C(T-1, T'-1) + (K-T') * C(T-1, T')`; numeral facts `42`, `60*7 > 4*102`, `10*102 = 17*60`. Paired with `T1k` and explicit `F_101` `(6,3,3)` rate-`10/17` 20/20 zero-error witness (`data/f101_t3_k3_e6_witness.json`, Python + C11 `f101-t3k3`).
- `T1b`: Closed-form `K <-> T` symmetry and strict algebraic inequality over the Sun-Zhang (`arXiv:2610.37412`) linear full-support-rank capacity formula (surplus `(K-1)(T-1)E^2 > 0`; at `T=2` reproduces `arXiv:2603.10769` Thm. IV.4; achievability for `T>=3` is a paper claim outside Lean beyond the certified witnesses).
- `T1c`: Arithmetic double-counting implication, `K+1 < 2K`, denominator identity at `E = K+1`, and kernel check of 90 tabulated `F_11` matrix inverses (`checkF11ByzantineRate25 = true`).
- `T1d`: Natural-number threshold equivalences (`E >= 4` for `K=2, T=2`; `E >= 6` for `K=2, T=3`; `(K+1)*mu <= E*mu`); flag privacy is a prose reading.
- `T1e`: Pure-integer scale-128 12-variable polymatroid `h_uncond` kernel-checked (`[propext]` only) for all 12 monotonicity checks, all 330 canonical `S_4` orbits (covering the 67,584 elemental submodularity inequalities via permutation invariance), 99 listed equalities, and 1,485 singleton Ingletons at value ratio `8/13 > 3/5`. Python enumerates all 67,584 elemental triples and 3,814,209 6-atom Ingletons with 0 violations.
- `T1f`: Classical projective `P^3` dichotomy over any `SimpleField F`: four pairwise-intersecting 2-subspaces of `F^4` are concurrent or coplanar.
- `T1g`: Algebraic Zhang-Yeung (1998) identity `ZY98(A,B;C,D) = Ing(C,D;A,B) + I(A;C|D) + I(A;D|C) + I(C;D|A)` + symmetric `M >= 3` denominator identity.
- `T1h`: 7-parameter non-Shannon cone reduction + `matusFamilyQ s` (`forall s : Nat`, equal to `ZY98` at `s=1`) + all-`M` contraction inequality.
- `T1i`: 23 `F_2`/`F_3` linear-subspace rays and denominator-3 decompositions covering all 510 four-marginals (495 singleton + 15 retrieval) and all 6 five-object retrieval marginals of `h_uncond` (backed by in-Lean `HasSpanDim` soundness in `T1k`, closing `L02`).
- `T1j`: 6-subspace arrangement in `F_2^{64}` matching all 64 subsets of the 6-object retrieval marginal `(W_1, W_2, A_1..A_4)` of `h_uncond` via `gf2RankSparse` at scale 4, proven equal to true vector-space `HasSpanDim (Fin 2) 64` by `T1k` (inequalities in 5 or more variables involving individual storage symbols remain open).
- `T1k`: NEW in `v5.2.0` (`LinearRankSoundness.lean` + `PIRProtocol.lean`, closing `L02` & `S01`/`A02`): defines standard vector-space `InSpan`, `LinIndep`, `HasSpanDim`, proves Steinitz uniqueness, `gf2RankSparse_sound`, `matRankModP_sound_f2`, `matRankModP_sound_f3`, and `t1j_ret6_true_f2_span_dim`; AND over any `SimpleField F`, formalizes the 2-file, `N`-server, `K`-MDS linear flag-private PIR protocol proving exact zero-error decoding (`pir_zero_error_decoding_exact` for both `theta in {0,1}`) and an explicit two-sided colluder-transcript bijection `Psi_I` (`pir_exact_t_privacy_bijection`), instantiated in Python & C11 by `data/f101_t3_k3_e6_witness.json` (20/20 `GL_20` flag isos, 10/10 live decode trials, 20/20 exact bijections at rate `10/17 > 4/7`).

## Pillar II — Module-LWE Reduction Tightness, `Dyadic-256..16384-A/B`, Bai Engine & QGTL (`CS-026`, `QC-042`, `CM-048`)
- `T2a`: Elementary diagonal-product identity `q^m` over any `CommRing R` (records the `q`-ary MLWE basis determinant; no matrix is defined and no published claim is refuted; `arXiv:2604.15858` is Luo Part I on Weber's conjecture while the determinant-ideal step is in Part IV `arXiv:2605.17412`).
- `T2b`: Ring-universal anti-periodic DFT even-mode cancellation (`f_hat(2k) = 0`) + odd `c,D` parity witness (proposed explanation of Chen ePrint 2024/555 Step 9; the Step 9 bug was found by Hongxun Wu and Thomas Vidick).
- `T2c`: Exact `CBD_2` (`Var=1, mu_4=5/2`) and `CBD_3` (`Var=3/2, mu_4=6`) integer moments, cyclotomic geometric-sum identity over any `SimpleField F`, and numerical 60-digit `4.96x` Renyi-2 ratio (`37.84` vs `7.63` bits).
- `T2d`: Integer covariance-numerator identities for shifted weight tables (shift invariance, zero on symmetric weights, `-512` at shift 1; QGTL Berry curvature reading in prose).
- `T2e`: Integer Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, moments of 8-bit `Dyadic-256` `(1,14,63,100,63,14,1)/256` (numerical `17.7x` Renyi-2 reduction to `2.14` bits), and covariance-variance PSD inequality.
- `T2f`: Universal `m`-twisted DFT selection rule over ANY `CommRing R` (`[propext]` alone; `QC-042`).
- `T2g`: Cleared-denominator variance/Renyi-2 inequality + moments of 9-bit `Dyadic-512` `(1,8,44,120,166,120,44,8,1)/512` (numerical `12.89x` ML-KEM-512 drop to `0.592` bits).
- `T2h`: All-order integer Holder inequality, integer TV-`chi^2` inequality, and moments of 10-bit `Dyadic-1024-A/B` (numerical Bai et al. 2018 reductions `67.14 -> 7.31` b `9.19x` and `24.77 -> 5.13` b `4.83x`).
- `T2i`: Cleared-denominator DPI, product-multiplicativity, and max-ratio inequalities + moments of 14-bit `Dyadic-16384-A/B` (numerical Bai reductions: ML-KEM-1024 `67.14 -> 6.013` b `11.17x`, ML-KEM-512 `24.77 -> 0.5916` b `41.9x`; exact coupled FIPS 203 DFRs `e^T r - s^T(e_1+c_u)+e_2+c_v` cross-verified by 90-digit Kronecker exact interval oracle matching NIST Table 1 within `0.04` b: `CBD_2` `2^-174.76`, `Dyadic-16384-A` `2^-171.80`, unit-var Gaussian `2^-171.12`, `1%` shrinkage `sigma=0.990` restores `2^-177.25 < 2^-174.8`; `Dyadic-16384-B` `2^-136.19`, `S02` closed in `v5.2.0`).

## Pillar III — Complexity-Theoretic, Algebraic & Zero-Reals Capacity Bridges (`CS-001`, `CS-004`, `CS-010`, `CS-012`, `CS-051`, `CS-CMP-012`)
- `T3a`: Constructive existence and uniqueness of the multilinear extension over any `SimpleField F` (standard).
- `T3b`: Natural-number counting inequality of the Razborov-Rudich Natural Proofs argument (no PRF or circuit defined in Lean).
- `T3c`: A `B`-error-correcting code has minimum Hamming distance `d_min >= 2B + 1` (Katz-Trevisan / Byzantine PIR context in prose).
- `T3d`: Exact NIST FIPS 203 Eq. (4.7) `mlkemCompress1(x) = ((4*(x mod 3329) + 3329) / 6658) % 2` (fixed in `v5.1.0`, `L01`), proved equivalent to `((2*(x mod 3329) + 1664) / 3329) % 2` for all `x : Int`, with exact margins `|e| <= 832` (`b=0`) and `-832 <= e <= 831` (`b=1`), sharp failures at `b=0, e=+833` and `b=1, e=+832`, and additive depth ceiling `M <= floor(831 / b_step)`.
- `T3e`: Field-universal Koszul-flattening bounds `rank_F(<2,2,2>) >= 6` and `rank_F(T_3) >= 5` over every `SimpleField F` (known; first superseded by `T3h`).
- `T3f`: Pigeonhole non-surjectivity and Markov averaging bound (Shannon circuit counting and LDC smoothness context in prose).
- `T3g`: Symbolic ALL-`m` monomial left-inverse proving `rank_F(<m,m,m>) >= m^2 + 2` for every `m >= 2` and every `SimpleField F` (weaker than `T3i` and published bounds).
- `T3h`: Characteristic-free formalization of known Exact Strassen-Winograd `rank_F(<2,2,2>) = 7` over EVERY `SimpleField F` (incl. `F_2`).
- `T3i`: Field-universal substitution-method rectangular & quadratic MatMul lower bound `rank_F(<m,k,p>) >= max(mk+mp-m, mk+kp-k, mp+kp-p)`, `rank_F(<m,m,m>) >= 2m^2 - m` (weaker for `m >= 2` than Brockett-Dobkin 1978 `2m^2 - 1` and Blaser `2.5m^2 - 3m`), and `rank_F(<m,2,p>) >= mp + 3`.
- `T3j`: Field-universal Haemers rank bound `|S| <= r^t`, zero-reals `Z[sqrt(5)]` SOS integer form of Lovasz's `Theta(C_5) = sqrt(5)` (`k^2 <= 5^t` and `alpha >= 5^m`), and exact `C_7` minimum Haemers rank `= 4` over every field `F`.
- `T3k`: Characteristic-free formalization of known Schwartz-Zippel (`|Z(P) cap S^n| <= d |S|^{n-1}`) + two-sided Strassen bound `2 * 4^k - 2^k <= rank_F(<2^k,2^k,2^k>) <= 7^k` (`forall k, F`).
- `T3l`: Conditional zero-reals `Z[sqrt(4k+1)]` 2-block conference-matrix SOS theorem proving `s^2 <= (4k+1)^t` and `alpha(G^{box 2m}) >= (4k+1)^m` for self-complementary conference graphs on `4k+1` vertices (Lovasz 1979; hypotheses proved in Lean for `P_5, P_13, P_17`, checked in C11/Python through `P_41`).

## Explicit Non-Claims (OPEN — `0 / 1,900` Grand Problems Retired)
- `P != NP` & explicit circuit lower bounds (`CS-001` / `CS-010`) remain OPEN.
- Matrix multiplication exponent `omega = 2` (`CS-004`) & Valiant `VP != VNP` (`CS-012`) remain OPEN.
- Non-linear `C(2,4,2,2) in [3/5, 8/13]` (inequalities in `>= 5` variables involving individual storage symbols remain open), Sun-Tao-Xu-Zhang max-redundancy (`arXiv:2603.10769` Sec. VII-B.2), general `T >= 4` zero-error schemes, and general `M >= 3` non-LFSR PIR (`CS-053`) remain OPEN.
- Exact Shannon capacity `Theta(C_7) in [sqrt(10), theta(C_7) ~ 3.317667]` (`CS-CMP-012`) remains OPEN.
- Worst-case quantum hardness lower bounds for MLWE (`CS-026` / `QC-042`) remain OPEN.
